JUPITER INCIDENT · 2011

Contact with the Jupiter crew was lost. Board the shuttle, survive the 30-second trip, land on Jupiter, find the four scattered data nodes in the storm (and watch out for the walking keys) and copy each one with your flash drive.

WASD move · Mouse look (click to capture, or drag) · Left click shoot · Hold right click aim · E interact · Space jump · Shift sprint · P pause

Controller (Xbox): L-stick move · R-stick look · RT shoot · LT aim · A jump / continue · X interact · LB or L3 sprint · Hold B skip flight · Start begin/pause · Y CaseOh mode (if unlocked)

Touch: left side drag = move · right side drag = look · FIRE / AIM / JUMP / USE / RUN buttons
